p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, starting a business, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: Rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, open the official updated sources, then read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for a product and a country, customs duties, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (MAM): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health rules set for products in this country
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade with and within the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: customs code and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check if a platform has been signalled by a regulator before entrusting money to it
p.espaces.rg_note: A site opens in your own language: use the translation of your browser, or « Understand a document » for a document in your own language.
p.espaces.cu_d: Taxes, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, shippers and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between countries.24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: an authorized customs broker (freight forwarder) can do this for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): tariffs and rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): duties, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_t4: French Customs: EORI, customs clearance, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: sea freight document, air freight document, CMR road freight document
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to get reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (EU importing or exporting companies)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods cleared for export to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; after that, risks and costs are borne by the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: the seller pays for freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such lists are rejected and may be reported.
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the fees for your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn anything from these links: compare here, then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Worldwide money transfer prices (World Bank): the real cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, fees displayed before sending
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total you receive: fees + exchange rate, a worse than market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose the way the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An ID is often required, both for shipping and collection.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you’ve only met online or to “unlock” a prize, parcel, loan or visa: it’s almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check on their website when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, calculate the real price, stay within the limits of the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier delivers directly to your customer. Easy to start, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no unauthorised regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (the "Wholesale / supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the actual price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT in the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: business status, VAT and taxes depending on your country (see business rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect for consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A provider who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a parcel from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
